# 1 Enoch Chapter 107 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source Manuscript:** Ge'ez MS; cf. 4QEn (Aramaic) | **Section:** Birth of Noah (Appendix)

---

**107:1** After that I explained to him all the secrets of the book of Enoch and all the parables that had been given to me in them, and summed them up for him.

**107:2** And he departed and called the name of that son Noah; for he will comfort the earth after all the destruction.

**107:3** Another son was born to him after the flood who was called Nir, and all the secrets of his mystery were shown to Noah concerning the destruction that was approaching during the generation that Nir and his son were to rule over.

---

*SOPHIA notes: LOGOS register adopted. V. 2's name etymology "Noah — he will comfort the earth" is preserved exactly — it echoes Genesis 5:29 and provides the theological rationale for the child's survival. V. 3's Nir reference is preserved intact without expansion — the brevity is original and the mystery is intentional. Divergences logged.*
